quest.title: The Key That Unlocks Fate
quest.description: Near the Collective of Plenty, you agree to help Iansan conduct a patrol. However, you stumble upon something completely unexpected...
quest.rewards_formatted: Adventure EXP x875, Mora x38100, Hero's Wit x4, Mystic Enhancement Ore x7

chapter.title: A Space and Time for You

talks.objective: Head to the Collective of Plenty

dialogues.speaker: Iansan
dialogues.text: Oh, "Tum{RUBY#[S]Hope}aini" and Paimon... Fancy that. I didn't expect to run into you two here.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Oh, hey! Coach Iansan! What are you doing here all by yourself?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Uh... Just so you know, Paimon didn't come here to train... Paimon's not looking to sign up for any diet plan or bodybuilding class right now.

dialogues.speaker: Iansan
dialogues.text: Hahaha... Alright, got it. But seriously, what do you take me for? Some coach from hell? I'd never force a student into something they didn't wanna do.

dialogues.speaker: Iansan
dialogues.text: That being said... A little aerobic exercise would probably do you some good. You could take over my patrol for a while, that would count...

choices.text: Hmm, rather than training...

response.speaker: Iansan
response.text: Yeah, all jokes aside — you're right. I'm looking for some help.

response.speaker: Iansan
response.text: The Collective of Plenty is holding a bodybuilding competition soon, and so many people have been busy squeezing in their last-minute workouts that we've run out of staff for patrols.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Oh, so you've stepped in to cover their work. But... don't you have a last-minute workout to do, too?

response.speaker: Iansan
response.text: I'm good. For one thing, I believe peak conditioning can only be achieved through consistent training over a long timespan. Cramming in a workout at the last minute does next to nothing for you.

response.speaker: Iansan
response.text: But more pertinently... Well, as you can probably imagine, I'm not able to compete in any of the most popular weight classes, and there's no real competition in my own weight class...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Yeah, that makes sense...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: ...Ohh no, don't look at Paimon like that! We are not the same weight class, and no way is Paimon competing against you!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: #{NICKNAME}, let's just help with the patrol, alright? Otherwise, Iansan's gonna make Paimon enter a bodybuilding competition...

response.speaker: Iansan
response.text: Hahaha... Perfect, I managed to get you on board with just one look.

choices.text: Alright, I'll do it for you, Paimon.

response.speaker: Iansan
response.text: Thank you both. It should be pretty routine — just keep your eyes peeled and make sure nothing strange is going on in the area.

response.speaker: Iansan
response.text: That'll free me up to check the other section. Let's meet back at the settlement when we're both done.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Sure thing! Just leave it to us. We're experts at strolling and patrolling, don't you worry.

choices.text: Alright, Coach, we'll help you out.
That sounds more like helping you out.

talks.objective: Patrol the area near the Collective of Plenty
Check on the situation in the cave

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Hey, there's a hilichurl here! Is it... sleeping? Doesn't look very hostile.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Why is it hiding away here?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Ah, you woke it up...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Huh!? It ran away... Guess our reputation in Natlan is more fearsome than we thought. Even hilichurls don't wanna mess with us now.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: There's something on the ground.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: You mean that shiny thing? Must've dropped it as it ran off.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Huh... Paimon bets that hilichurl thought it was a priceless treasure. It was probably planning to hide it here for safekeeping... until we showed up.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Let Paimon take a look! Hilichurls aren't the brightest, so it might not be worth much, but still...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: #What is it, {NICKNAME}? You look so serious all of a sudden...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Isn't this just a regular old key? Hmm, the style is unusual, though. Doesn't look Natlanese... Where do you think it's from?

choices.text: This is...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: What do you mean? What hibernation chamber? What spaceship?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: *gasp* Wait, you mean... THE spaceship? The one that brought you to Teyvat!?

response.speaker: Player
response.text: That's the one.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: So... how did that key show up here? Are you sure you didn't just drop it?

choices.text: No, I still have mine...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Whoa... Yeah, these look identical... So if one of them's yours, does that mean... the other one is...

choices.text: There are only two of these.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Knew it... Whew, the keys to a spaceship. Huh, somehow, that really rams home the fact that you really are an actual alien... Wait, no, Descender.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: ...But anyway, now we know where it came from, the question is — how did it get here? Hmm...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: #The simplest explanation is that your {M#sister}{F#brother} lost {M#her}{F#his} key somewhere not far from here, then that hilichurl found it and ducked into the nearest cave to hide it...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: #If that's true... It means your {M#sister}{F#brother} was here recently.

choices.text: And by extension...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: #Yeah... Man, this is so crazy. We only agreed to help with Iansan's patrol on a whim, and now we've made this bombshell discovery and found a huge lead on your {M#sister}{F#brother}...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Should we keep following this trail while it's hot? Or do you think we should check back in with Iansan?

response.speaker: Iansan
response.text: Ah, there you are. Looks like you went the extra mile today — thanks for being so diligent.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Oh, hey, Iansan! What's up? Didn't think we'd see you again till we headed back to the settlement...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: We were actually just about to go meet up with you. We've made a huge discovery today!

response.speaker: Iansan
response.text: I came here to let you know that you don't need to keep patrolling anymore. The bodybuilding competition has just been canceled, so the usual squad will be resuming their normal duties. They'll be here to take over shortly.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Wait, canceled? Why, what happened?

response.speaker: Iansan
response.text: The Abyss Order attacked.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Huh!?

response.speaker: Player
response.text: Didn't expect our suspicions to be confirmed so quickly.

response.speaker: Player
response.text: #(Sounds like {M#Lumine}{F#Aether} is on the move again.)

response.speaker: Player
response.text: #(I'll find a way to speak with {M#her}{F#him} in person this time. I have to.)

response.speaker: Iansan
response.text: I've heard of the Abyss Order, but this is the first time I've known them to take organized action on such a large scale.

response.speaker: Iansan
response.text: It's like they're... preparing to go to war against our entire nation.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: One little sect versus the entire nation of war? How are they expecting to pull that off?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Based on everything we've seen from them so far, they usually prefer to act in the shadows. So, what's different about it this time? What could they be after?

response.speaker: Iansan
response.text: No clue. All we know is that they've attacked our tribe, but that doesn't tell us much.

response.speaker: Iansan
response.text: Our defenses are holding strong so far, so I'm gonna head to the Stadium of the Sacred Flame and see what Mavuika knows. If there is any information out there, she's the one people report to.

response.speaker: Iansan
response.text: #Want to come with me, {NICKNAME}? I'm sure everyone will feel better knowing that the hero of Natlan is on the case.

choices.text: Well, I am keen to find out more about the situation.

response.speaker: Iansan
response.text: Great, then let's head over together.

choices.text: And I can provide some information on the Abyss Order.
The Abyss Order was probably here as well.
#One belongs to me, and the other, to my {M#sister}{F#brother}.
...I've always made sure to keep it safe and sound.
The key to the Hibernation Chamber on the spaceship.

talks.objective: Go to the Speaker's Chamber to look for Mavuika

dialogues.speaker: Iansan
dialogues.text: Mavuika!

dialogues.speaker: Mavuika
dialogues.text: #Oh? Great timing, Iansan. I was just about to send someone for you. And it's good to see {NICKNAME}'s with you.

dialogues.speaker: Iansan
dialogues.text: How are things looking? What's the latest word from the messengers?

dialogues.speaker: Mavuika
dialogues.text: The Abyss Order has been spotted near several tribes at the same time. Clearly, this is a coordinated strike.

dialogues.speaker: Mavuika
dialogues.text: Also, their numbers are much higher than expected. Their organization appears to have grown considerably, but because they're usually so secretive, this is the first we're learning of it.

dialogues.speaker: Iansan
dialogues.text: It sounds like they're throwing everything they have at us... What are they trying to achieve?

dialogues.speaker: Mavuika
dialogues.text: That's what I'd like to know as well. Historically, Natlan has not been a hotbed of Abyss Order activity, and we have no particular quarrel with them.

dialogues.speaker: Iansan
dialogues.text: Could it be... revenge, perhaps? Would they want to get back at us for our recent victory over the Abyss?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Seems unlikely... But then again, Paimon wouldn't put anything past the Abyss Order.

dialogues.speaker: Mavuika
dialogues.text: It's too early to say anything definite. For the time being, we should continue monitoring the situation.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: How are the battles going? Not too many casualties, hopefully?

dialogues.speaker: Mavuika
dialogues.text: Well, even if they're committing all their forces to the fight, they're in for a tough time. Our brave warriors have just emerged victorious from an all-out fight against the Abyss itself.

dialogues.speaker: Iansan
dialogues.text: Yep. We have a whole nation's worth of seasoned veterans fighting for us.

dialogues.speaker: Mavuika
dialogues.text: Compared to the true Abyss, the Abyss Order poses a far smaller threat. They cannot endlessly replenish their forces, for starters.

dialogues.speaker: Mavuika
dialogues.text: However, this is still a war, so we must give it our all, and do our utmost to minimize casualties.

dialogues.speaker: Mavuika
dialogues.text: #The tribes are organizing their defenses as we speak. {NICKNAME}, this is one war that Natlan can handle on its own. If you wish to stay out of it, you'll be safe here at the Stadium with me.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: No, this one is personal for me...

dialogues.speaker: Mavuika
dialogues.text: Oh? In what way...?

choices.text: The current leader of the Abyss Order...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Yep, that's how it is.

response.speaker: Mavuika
response.text: I see... My goodness. That is... very personal indeed.

response.speaker: Mavuika
response.text: #If you don't mind me asking, do you have any idea what {M#her}{F#his} goal could be?

response.speaker: Player
response.text: That's what I want to know as well.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Safe to say, they're not exactly on the best terms at the moment.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: #Ever since Paimon met {NICKNAME}, {M#he}{F#she}'s been trying to track {M#his sister}{F#her brother} down and get some answers. But {M#she}{F#he}'s been avoiding {M#him}{F#her}.

response.speaker: Iansan
response.text: I see. So you two have fallen out... Heh, a pretty common occurrence between siblings.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Well, yeah, that may be... But the stakes are a little higher where these two are involved!

response.speaker: Mavuika
response.text: #They certainly are... Although somehow, it doesn't surprise me that a spat between {NICKNAME} and twin could affect the fate of the entire world.

response.speaker: Mavuika
response.text: Just so I'm clear — you're still on Natlan's side, and you have no idea what your sibling is after. Is that right?

choices.text: Absolutely.

response.speaker: Mavuika
response.text: Haha, well that's a relief. When you first mentioned your sibling, I was worried we were about to be thrust into an impossible position.

response.speaker: Mavuika
response.text: Our reports say that the Abyss Order has focused most of their efforts against the Masters of the Night-Wind.

response.speaker: Mavuika
response.text: If you don't plan on staying here with me, I'd recommend going there to lend them a hand.

response.speaker: Player
response.text: Sounds great.

response.speaker: Iansan
response.text: I'll join you. Right now, the Collective of Plenty isn't facing a serious threat, so we should support the other tribes.

response.speaker: Mavuika
response.text: Many thanks, you two. Anything you need, send word to me right away.

choices.text: I might even hate the Abyss Order more than you do.
#Is my {M#sister}{F#brother}.

talks.objective: Go to the Masters of the Night-Wind to provide support

dialogues.speaker: Citlali
dialogues.text: Phew... Much better. That's more like it!

dialogues.speaker: Iansan
dialogues.text: Impressive work, Granny Itztli. If I'd known you were on the case already, I might have reconsidered whether your tribe really needed reinforcements.

dialogues.speaker: Citlali
dialogues.text: Hah! If anyone should be reconsidering, it's the Abyss Order. They picked the wrong target this time!

dialogues.speaker: Iansan
dialogues.text: Experience says that if we head in the direction they were attacking from, we should find their stronghold.

dialogues.speaker: Iansan
dialogues.text: Why don't we press our advantage and destroy their base? They won't know what hit 'em.

dialogues.speaker: Sutura
dialogues.text: Hey, was there a battle here just now? Need any help?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Ah, the warriors from the Masters of the Night-Wind are here!

dialogues.speaker: Iansan
dialogues.text: The battle against the Abyss is still fresh on our minds, so everyone's used to working together.

dialogues.speaker: Iansan
dialogues.text: Well, morale's high and everyone's here. Let's go take down that stronghold!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Look, it's Citlali!

dialogues.speaker: Citlali
dialogues.text: Huh, I wasn't expecting to see you here. Are you here to reinforce us?

dialogues.speaker: Iansan
dialogues.text: How are things looking? Mavuika told us to come here.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Huh... The situation must be pretty dire if it's managed to get Citlali out of the house...

dialogues.speaker: Citlali
dialogues.text: Dire... No, I wouldn't go that far. It's mostly just... irritating.

dialogues.speaker: Citlali
dialogues.text: I heard we're being hit the hardest out of all the tribes. What are they trying to imply? They just think we're pushovers, or something?

dialogues.speaker: Citlali
dialogues.text: The more I thought about it, the angrier I got. I couldn't exactly concentrate on my novel after that, so... Hmph, well, here I am.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: So that's how they earned the ire of Granny Itztli, huh...

dialogues.speaker: Citlali
dialogues.text: They call themselves the "Abyss Order," yes? So tasteless. It's exactly the kind of two-dimensional name a clueless writer picks because they don't trust the rest of their writing to persuade the reader of who the real villains are...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: #Hey, she's saying your {M#sister}{F#brother} has poor taste...

choices.text: I'm just glad I'm not the only one who thinks that.

response.speaker: Citlali
response.text: #Wait, what? Are you saying... {M#his sister}{F#her brother} is a member of the Abyss Order?

response.speaker: Citlali
response.text: (I only said that because I was mad... but maybe I went too far?)

response.speaker: Iansan
response.text: Hey, let's save the chat for later. We've got some enemies incoming.

response.speaker: Citlali
response.text: Good! A much-needed chance to vent my frustration! And not a moment too soon — things were getting awkward there. Luckily, I'll never have to find out just how badly the rest of that conversation was gonna go.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: You didn't have to say that last part out loud, Citlali... Anyway, let's get 'em!

choices.text: #If I were {M#her}{F#him}, I'd have changed that name long ago.

talks.objective: Launch a counterattack against the Abyss Order

dialogues.speaker: Iansan
dialogues.text: This stronghold is neutralized. Good work, everyone.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Hmph, the Abyss Order's all bark and no bite.

dialogues.speaker: Citlali
dialogues.text: To be honest, this was anticlimactic. I was hoping for a personal apology at the very least. And ideally, a whole speech acknowledging the superior might of the Masters of the Night-Wind...

dialogues.speaker: Citlali
dialogues.text: Well, whatever. I'll just have to make up for it with some extra wine at the victory feast.

dialogues.speaker: Iansan
dialogues.text: With the stronghold cleared, this area should be safe for the time being. But still... something tells me we can't afford to let our guard down yet.

dialogues.speaker: Iansan
dialogues.text: Maybe it's just me, but an enemy under siege normally defends their stronghold at all costs. The fighting gets more and more intense, right till the bitter end.

dialogues.speaker: Iansan
dialogues.text: But this time was different. With a few exceptions, most of the enemies here gave up and fled the moment that... Well, I don't know, but it seemed like they sensed something.

dialogues.speaker: Citlali
dialogues.text: Huh? Not sure I follow... They did a tactical retreat, that's all. It's just a different strategy.

dialogues.speaker: Iansan
dialogues.text: I'm not convinced... Don't forget, they're radicals who chose to wage war on an entire nation. They don't do things in half measures. It seems out-of-character to cut their losses and run like that.

dialogues.speaker: Citlali
dialogues.text: So you're saying, there's more to this than meets the eye?

dialogues.speaker: Iansan
dialogues.text: I'm saying we don't know enough to be sure of anything at this stage. So let's stay alert and keep our defenses at the ready.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: (So, we're no wiser as to the Abyss Order's objective. Back to square one...)

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: #(If I could only get {M#Lumine}{F#Aether} to talk to me, I could get answers for all of us.)

choices.text: I'm heading back to the Collective of Plenty.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Paimon had a hunch you might say that.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: But you're right. If we can somehow use that key to track down your sibling, maybe we can end this war before things get serious. And maybe you can finally get some answers.

response.speaker: Citlali
response.text: Wait, you're leaving? But I was still debating whether to invite you to the first victory feast...

response.speaker: Iansan
response.text: Go ahead, you two. Citlali and I will take care of things here.

choices.text: That key is our only lead so far.

dialogues.speaker: Mavuika
dialogues.text: And don't worry, you're still Natlan's hero. I'm not going to blame you for something your sibling has done.

dialogues.speaker: Mavuika
dialogues.text: #Still, if we manage to find your {M#sister}{F#brother}... You wouldn't mind if I gave {M#her}{F#him} a good punch to teach {M#her}{F#him} a lesson, would you?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Hmm, what's this? Was there always a cave here?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: We should go take a look, right? Seems like a thing to do on a patrol.
